name: Codex transport
responsibility: The wire under the session: one newline-framed JSON object at a time, each way
description: TASK-653.11: the transport decodes and encodes frames only through decodeFrame, decodeFrameBody and encodeFrame, and frame-lines.ts makes the transport error for a frame the encoder refused. A client request is refused in its old order: closed, method, params, then the pending-request cap, and only then is an id minted, so a malformed request on a full queue gets the usage refusal and mints nothing.
